Questions

What happens after I sign up?

Enter your name and number, then you’ll continue to secure payment for your plan. I’ll use your details to get in touch about your plan.

How much is personal training?

It’s a custom quote. The price depends on what you want and what I can offer, so tap “Get my quote” and I’ll reach out.

Is this good for beginners?

Yes. Every plan is matched to your experience level, from first-timers to people who’ve trained for years.

Do I need a gym?

No. Tell me what you have, whether that’s a full gym, a few dumbbells or just your bodyweight, and I’ll build around it.

Can I cancel the nutrition plan?

Yes, any time. It’s month to month.
